== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-collision-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Collision! (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words and line breaks as the 2017 slip. This is a full card image again, 349 × 489 pixels, with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
